questions.q: What's the golden rule for using AI to write messages?
options: Let AI decide what to say, since it writes better
Use AI for formal emails only, never for texts
Paste the whole thread and let AI choose your reply
You bring the substance, and AI handles the wording
questions.explain: AI is excellent at how to say something, but only you know what to say, so give it your key points and let it shape them.

questions.q: You're upset and have drafted an angry reply to a message. What should you do before sending it?
options: Send it right away, while your feelings are fresh and honest
Ask AI to make the reply sound even firmer and sharper
Ask AI how it will come across, then for a calmer version
Delete your draft and let AI reply without your input
questions.explain: The lesson suggests asking how your draft is likely to come across, then rewriting it so it's honest about how you feel but calm and constructive.

questions.q: AI drafted an email that sounds stiff and corporate, not like you. What's the best fix?
options: Send it anyway, since polished messages always work best
Give it samples of your writing and do the final edit yourself
Ask it to add phrases like "I hope this email finds you well"
Ask it to make the whole email longer and more formal
questions.explain: To keep your own voice, give AI a sample of your messages, ban the clichés and do the final edit yourself with a personal touch.
